resources.string: On: the phone\'s assistant can use the list and the meal plan
An assistant on this phone, such as Gemini, can then add items to the shopping list and read the list, the meal plan and your recipes. What it reads may be sent to the assistant\'s own service.
Allow the assistant when the app is locked
Otherwise Tandem only answers the assistant within the lock\'s time after you have unlocked the app.
The assistant only gets an answer while Tandem is unlocked. Under More > Lock the app you can allow it while the app is locked.
The assistant gets an answer even while Tandem is locked. You can change this under More > Lock the app.

• Add items to the shopping list, for example “add milk to the list”
• Read what is left to buy
• Read the meal plan for a day
• Search your recipes and open one, or its cook mode
It can never remove or check off anything.
Assistants can use apps like this from Android 16. On this phone the setting does nothing.
You are a guest in this Tandoor space, so the assistant can read but not add anything.
In demo mode the assistant uses the sample data on this phone and nothing is sent to a server.
